name: premium-commercial-ppt-skill
description: Hermes skill project for premium Chinese commercial PPT planning, PPTX generation, and visual QA.

scripts.sample: mkdir -p out/preview && node scripts/generate_pptx.js examples/sample-deck-plan.json out/sample.pptx && node scripts/validate_pptx.js out/sample.pptx --expect-slides 10 --require 新能源,告警 --preview-dir out/preview
scripts.validate:skill:
node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const s=fs.readFileSync('SKILL.md','utf8'); if(!s.startsWith('---')) throw new Error('SKILL.md must start with frontmatter'); const end=s.indexOf('
---
',3); if(end<0) throw new Error('frontmatter close not found'); if(!/
name:\s*premium-commercial-ppt/.test(s)) throw new Error('name missing'); if(!/
description:\s+/.test(s)) throw new Error('description missing'); console.log('SKILL.md basic validation ok')"
